name: zclass_camera_set_flag_bit0
description: zClass_Camera::gwCameraSetFlagBit0 validates a camera node and toggles bit 0 in the recovered camera data flags field.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera helper; tier S verification is deferred to the zClass camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x449d20 validates the camera-node checks, zError reporting dependency on invalid inputs, bit-0 set/clear behavior, and zero return on success.
The native zClass camera smoke verifies setting and clearing the camera flag bit, plus null-node and wrong-class validation error returns.
